name: com.realtydataapi/mcp-server
title: RealtyDataAPI — Zillow & Redfin Real Estate Property MCP. Zero-signup x402 U
description: Zillow & Redfin Real Estate Property MCP. Zero-signup x402 USDC ($0.002) on Base or free API key

tools.name: search_properties_for_sale
tools.description: Search active US & Canada for-sale residential properties by 5-digit ZIP code (e.g. "78701") or city/state (e.g. "Austin, TX"). Returns list price, AVM estimated value, instant equity %, price/sqft, beds/baths/sqft/lot/year_built, estimated monthly rent, gross cap rate %, HOA, days on market, photos, and listing agent. Cost: 2 Credits / listing returned (0 Credits if empty).

location.description: 5-digit US ZIP code (e.g. "78701") or City, State (e.g. "Austin, TX", "Miami, FL").

tools.name: search_rental_listings
tools.description: Search live residential rental listings across the US & Canada by ZIP code or city/state to benchmark market rent comps, rent per sq.ft, unit specs, pet/building flags, and leasing contacts. Cost: 2 Credits / rental listing returned (0 Credits if empty).

location.description: 5-digit US ZIP code (e.g. "78701") or City, State (e.g. "Austin, TX").

tools.name: get_property_valuation_and_comps
tools.description: Retrieve the complete Architectural Property Dossier for a specific property_id (or Realtor listing URL), including multi-provider AVM valuations (Quantarium, Collateral, CoreLogic), 37+ high-res photos, county tax assessment history, prior sale/price-change events, assigned school ratings, HOA fees, and listing broker info. Cost: 10 Credits / call (0 Credits if not found).

property_id.description: MLS / MPR property_id (e.g. "8241233717") or full Realtor.com listing URL.

tools.name: search_redfin_parcels
tools.description: Query Redfin parcel-level listings and multi-unit condo/apartment tower summaries for any US ZIP code or city, returning exact lat/lon coordinates, HOA monthly dues, price/sqft, days on market, 3D tour availability, and building unit inventory. Cost: 2 Credits / parcel returned (0 Credits if empty).

limit.description: Max normalized Redfin parcels to return (1–50).

tools.name: autocomplete_real_estate_location
tools.description: Resolve partial street addresses, ZIP codes, neighborhoods, or city names into canonical coordinates, state/postal codes, and direct MPR property_id handles for downstream valuation calls. Cost: 2 Credits / call.

query.description: Partial address, ZIP code, or city query (e.g. "78701", "901 W 9th St Austin", "Scottsdale").

tools.name: search_real_estate_agents
tools.description: Find verified Realtors, listing agents, and brokerages in any US ZIP code or metro with active listing counts, price ranges, 12-month closed sales volume, verified client ratings, phone numbers, and served neighborhoods. Cost: 2 Credits / agent returned (0 Credits if empty).

location.description: 5-digit US ZIP code (e.g. "78701") or City, State (e.g. "Austin, TX").

tools.name: analyze_property_cap_rate
tools.description: Underwrite a residential investment property by property_id: returns list price vs AVM market value, instant equity, estimated monthly rent, gross cap rate %, annual county property tax, monthly HOA dues, and nearby school ratings. Cost: 10 Credits / call.

property_id.description: MLS / MPR property_id (e.g. "8241233717") obtained from search_properties_for_sale or autocomplete_real_estate_location.
